# Pascal Pfohl — huskymillion

> Moving image from idea to final edit. Art direction for moving image, content production and motion design. Based in Zürich, Switzerland.

## Profile
- Name: Pascal Pfohl (huskymillion)
- Location: Zürich, Switzerland
- Focus: art direction for moving image · content production · motion design
- Scope: visual concept, direction, camera, edit, motion design, sound
- Languages: German (native), English (fluent), Swiss German (understanding, fluent)

## Selected work
- köttur — own streetwear label and brand film (16 mm). Role: founder, creative direction, concept, product design, script, direction.
- riders rights (syndicom, Freundliche Grüsse) — campaign film, trailer + case film in German and English, shot undercover with real couriers. Role: direction, visual concept, camera, edit, motion design, storytelling, sound direction.
- kapo bern (Kantonspolizei Bern, Freundliche Grüsse) — image campaign, 3 motifs across DOOH, OOH and social (9:16, 4:5, 16:9, still and moving), low-angle perspective on the people affected. Role: visual concept (film + photo), camera, photography, edit, motion design.
- woz «the news in the news» (WOZ Die Wochenzeitung, Freundliche Grüsse) — case film in stop-motion/cut-out style. Campaign: Gold, Best of Swiss Web 2025, Creativity. Role: direction, look, motion design, edit, sound.
- ewz × ekz «komm ins team power» (Freundliche Grüsse) — recruiting campaign, 2 lead spots + 4 cutdowns in 9:16, shot on snorricam. ewz and EKZ won the Swiss HR Award 2025 («Talente finden»). Role: film concept, camera, edit, motion design, sound design.
- schweizer paraplegiker-stiftung (Freundliche Grüsse) — 6 documentary job profiles for employer branding. Role: interview concept, camera, edit, motion design.
- mawave — in-house production built from scratch; agency content for TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn; personal brand content for founder Jason Modemann.
